metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Egeon at two, supper at the Bell, one pound back, two pounds to the brief, and six lines waiting.

yesterday: The brief is granted, and the gathering is still ahead. Quiney stood the wine. One pound of the August two is back. One pound is still owed.
Two pounds went to the town's collection, and he wrote the line. Ten pounds till Lady Day was asked once and refused.
The six lines for Anne are written. They wait for the carrier of the fourth.
The book has the two items. Michaelmas is still the last count.
His news was the ladder, the Sunday reading, Hallowmas, and the errand to Shottery.
